unsupported_operation_or_step: none for product identity; independent resynthesis not performed
precursor_access_status: reported ester mass/mmol inconsistency; incomplete scale/work-up
source_limitation: reported exact product; no project resynthesis
route_hypothesis: The selected product is the exact pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid reported as compound 5 in Raji et al.; the paper prepares it by LiOH hydrolysis of the corresponding ethyl ester (96% isolated yield). This is prior art for the exact candidate, not a new synthesis hypothesis.
source_urls: Raji et al., Bioorganic & Medicinal Chemistry 25 (2017) 1202–1218, DOI 10.1016/j.bmc.2016.12.032; experimental section reports the exact acid and ester hydrolysis.

unsupported_operation_or_step: stereodefined quaternary centre and carboxamide-compatible ring closure
precursor_access_status: precursor access, stereochemical control, and compatibility
route_hypothesis: A possible route would require a new stereodefined quaternary carbinol bearing cyclopropylethynyl and carboxamide substituents, followed by construction of the benzoxazinone. Existing efavirenz process disclosures use the CF3-bearing tertiary alcohol and cyclization chemistry; they do not establish the proposed CONH2 replacement.
source_urls: Patel et al. report benzoxazinone analogs with aromatic substitution changes; efavirenz process patent US9676735B2 describes the CF3-bearing chiral intermediate and cyanate-mediated ring closure. Neither source reports this candidate or the CONH2-for-CF3 transformation.

related_precedent: related aryl-substituted thiazole benzenesulfonamides; target is 2-methyl-4-(sulfamoylphenyl)-5-(p-tolyl)thiazole
unsupported_operation_or_step: target-specific Hantzsch precursor pair and regioselective assembly
precursor_access_status: ring-forming precursor pair, regioselectivity, and sulfonamide compatibility
route_hypothesis: A convergent route hypothesis is to form the substituted thiazole from a para-sulfamoyl aryl thioamide and a suitably substituted alpha-haloketone, or through another validated thiazole-forming sequence, then establish the para sulfonamide and aryl substitution pattern.
source_urls: WO2022076628A1 reports and characterizes diverse aryl-substituted thiazole benzenesulfonamides, including 4,5-diaryl thiazoles, but its examples attach benzenesulfonamide through thiazole N and do not report this candidate's C2-(sulfamoylphenyl) topology.

related_precedent: parent aprepitant morpholine construction and downstream installation; retained morpholine with modified pendant aryl groups
unsupported_operation_or_step: modified aryl ethanol, aniline protection/compatibility, and final assembly
precursor_access_status: candidate-specific aryl precursors and aniline compatibility
route_hypothesis: A route would need to rebuild the substituted morpholine and install the triazolinone-bearing N-substituent while setting the two ring stereocenters and benzylic ether stereochemistry. Aprepitant process literature provides route concepts for the parent morpholine, but its specific aryl and stereochemical pattern differs substantially.
source_urls: Brands et al. report crystallization-induced stereochemical control in aprepitant synthesis; EP2260029A1 describes a chiral-acid-mediated stereoselective morpholine process and downstream N-alkylation. These are parent-drug precedents, not a route to this modified scaffold.

related_precedent: pyridinecarboxamide and pyridyl-ether assembly; larger scaffold truncation
unsupported_operation_or_step: candidate-specific regioisomer, mono-arylation control, phenol retention, and assembly sequence
precursor_access_status: activated pyridine identity, mono-arylation selectivity, and sequence
route_hypothesis: A plausible assembly hypothesis is nucleophilic aromatic substitution between an activated chloropicolinamide and hydroquinone, retaining the para phenol. A primary patent demonstrates formation of N-methyl pyridinecarboxamides followed by coupling with aminophenols to form pyridyl ethers, but its pyridine regioisomer and phenol substitution differ.
source_urls: US7528255B2 reports 4-chloro-N-methyl-2-pyridinecarboxamide preparation and its reaction with aminophenols to form pyridyl ether intermediates. It does not report this exact hydroxyphenoxy product; the phenolic coupling partner and attachment positions differ.
